pages.title: Coordination Reactor
pages.text: A metal ion and its ligands, stirred until the right number settle round it in the right way.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the ligand field strength and the temperature. The splitting Δ against the pairing energy P decides the spin: each complex wants its own (the page says which), by a margin of 0.2 eV. Above 370 K the complex falls apart.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Copper Ammine Complex, Porphyrin Oxygen Carrier, Prussian Blue Pigment.
